name: cavemio-slider
title: Slider
description: One value or a range: a press throws the nearest thumb there, a drag tracks the finger, and the value rises out of the thumb.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each thumb is role="slider" with aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext.
- Reduced motion: thumbs move at once, no bubble motion.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: – · One number, or two for a range.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: – · When a drag or key press ends.

useCases.title: Price filters
useCases.description: A range from $10 to $90 in a shop sidebar.

useCases.title: Volume and playback
useCases.description: A single value with a live bubble.

features.title: Thrown, then tracked
features.description: A press animates the jump; the drag that follows has no lag.

features.title: Range that never crosses
features.description: Pass two values; each thumb stops at the other.

features.title: Keyboard
features.description: Arrows step, Page Up/Down step ten, Home/End jump.

features.title: Phone friendly
features.description: Vertical page scroll still works when a drag starts on it.

states.title: press
states.description: The nearest thumb is thrown to the point (420ms, slight overshoot) and grows to 1.15.

states.title: drag
states.description: The thumb follows 1:1, snapped to step.

states.title: bubble
states.description: The value rises from a 3px blur above the thumb and sinks 700ms after you stop.

states.title: focus
states.description: Ring and halo on the thumb from the keyboard.
